Open your eyes. The mainstream narrative wants you to believe this is just some simple rule change, but it is all a carefully orchestrated smoke screen by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. They are playing a massive psychological game with the public. 

Look at what they are claiming now: the International Olympic Committee announced that DSD athletes and transgender women will be excluded from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Do not fall for their deception. When IOC President Kirsty Coventry shamelessly states, “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” and claims the move will protect fairness and safety, you know the exact opposite is true. 

This isn't about protecting anything. It is a calculated distraction, a manufactured wedge designed to keep the masses divided while the architects of this global agenda advance their real, hidden control grids. Every official justification is a calculated inversion of their true motives.
